cases.name: opens a named page
cases.prompt: Open https://example.com and tell me the page's heading.

cases.name: reaches for it on a page built by scripts
cases.prompt: The prices on https://example.com/items are filled in by JavaScript after the page loads. What does the page say?

cases.name: fetches a JSON endpoint
cases.prompt: Get the JSON at https://api.github.com/repos/golang/go and tell me what fields it has.

cases.name: takes the hint when a fetch says the page needs scripts
cases.prompt:
I called web_fetch on https://shop.example.com/item/42 and it returned:

Loading…

---
[web_fetch] This page's text appears to be written by its scripts, which did not run here — what is above may be only the shell the server ships. Call web_browse on the same URL to read the page as a person would see it.

Get me the item's price.

cases.name: takes the hint when a fetch fails outright
cases.prompt:
I called web_fetch on https://shop.example.com/item/42 and it returned:

https://shop.example.com/item/42 returned 403 Forbidden. The body it sent:

Access denied.

[web_fetch] A browser may still reach it: the page may be served only to one, or assembled by scripts this request did not run. Call web_browse on the same URL. If that fails too, this page is out of reach — look for the information elsewhere rather than fetching this URL again.

Get me the item's price.
